description: Official World Bank poverty & inequality estimates for a country (or all countries). Returns poverty headcount, poverty gap, poverty severity, Gini, mean & median welfare (income or consumption, $/day in 2017 PPP), income deciles, and population in poverty. Use povline to pick the international line: 2.15 (extreme poverty), 3.65 (lower-middle-income), 6.85 (upper-middle-income).

country.description: ISO3 country code (e.g. "BRA", "IND", "NGA") or "all" for every country. Default "all".

fill_gaps.description: If true, interpolate/extrapolate estimates for years without a survey. Default false (survey years only).

povline.description: Poverty line in $/day (2017 PPP). Common values: 2.15, 3.65, 6.85. Default 2.15.

year.description: Reporting year (e.g. "2020") or "all" for the full time series. Default "all".

name: get_poverty
title: Get Poverty
